label: Safirum launches whitelisted CHF-S stablecoin on Solana
note: Safirum AG announced the live launch of Swiss franc stablecoin CHF-S on Solana Token-2022 on November 3, backed 1:1 by Swiss francs in segregated Swiss bank accounts with protocol-level KYC/KYB wallet whitelisting. Safirum has not published a mint address, supply figure, or reserve attestation.
